text: A tide gauge records the height of the sea surface against a fixed benchmark on land. Because the land itself rises or subsides, a record from a single gauge mixes two signals, and separating them needs a second instrument that is not attached to the shore.

Sourdough starters are cultures of wild yeast and lactic acid bacteria kept alive by regular feeding. The bacteria acidify the dough, which both flavours the bread and slows the growth of competing organisms, so an established starter is unusually stable.

In a queueing system, utilisation is the fraction of time a server is busy. Waiting time grows without bound as utilisation approaches one, which is why systems designed to run at ninety-five percent capacity feel fast until the day they do not.

The Bessemer process blew air through molten pig iron to burn off carbon. It cut the cost of steel by an order of magnitude, and it also made steel quality depend on the phosphorus content of the ore, which is why some regions adopted it decades later than others.

A cartographer choosing a projection is choosing which distortion to accept. Conformal projections preserve angles and inflate areas at high latitude; equal-area projections preserve areas and shear shapes. No projection of a sphere onto a plane preserves both.

Root pressure pushes water a short distance up a stem, but it cannot account for the height of a tall tree. The dominant mechanism is tension in a continuous water column, pulled from above as water evaporates from the leaves and held together by cohesion.
